youtube_description:
🇭🇰🏏 While our Men's team is preparing for the ICC Men's T20 World Cup Asia Qualifier, we have asked Head Coach Simon Willis for some question about the squad preparation. Let's hear some updates from Simon! 

The boys will face Kuwait tomorrow in the first game of the T20 World Cup Asia Qualifier. Livestream will be available on ICC.tv, and don't forget to follow our social media pages for more updates! 📺 📣
